data.gender_notes: Fayyazat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is a source of delight and joy. The name Fayyazat carries the meaning “Delightful one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fayyazat usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to a girl who brings happiness and joy to those around her
data.etymology: Fayyazat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delightful one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayyazat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فيّازة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفيّازة هي كلمة عربية مشتقة من الفعل فيّز الذي يعني النعمة والبركة والخير الكثير، وتستخدم هذه الكلمة في التراث الإسلامي للدعاء والابتهال إلى الله تعالى، كما تستخدم كاسم للإناث في العديد من البلدان العربية

in_urdu.name: فیاضہ
in_urdu.meaning: فیاضہ کا معنی ہے نعمتیں اور برکتیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیاضہ ایک عربی لفظ ہے جو فیاض سے مشتق ہے جس کا معنی ہے نعمتیں اور برکتیں، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں دعا اور عبادت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور پاکستان اور ہندوستان میں لڑکیوں کے نام کے طور پر بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़ियाज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: फ़ियाज़ा का अर्थ है आशीर्वाद और समृद्धि
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ियाज़ा एक अरबी शब्द है जो फ़ियाज़ से उत्पन्न हुआ है जिसका अर्थ है आशीर्वाद और समृद्धि, इस नाम का उपयोग इस्लामी परंपरा में प्रार्थना और उपासना के लिए किया जाता है, और भारत में लड़कियों के नाम के रूप में भी उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: فيّاضه
in_pashto.meaning: فيّاضه د nghĩa له نعمتونو او برکتونو
in_pashto.long_meaning: فيّاضه د عربي کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د فيّاض څخه مشتق شوی دی چې معنی یې نعمتونو او برکتونو ته ورګرځي، دا نوم د اسلامي دود په اساس د دعا او عبادتي لپاره کارېږي، او په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د نوم په توګه کارېږي

in_english.name: Fayyazat
in_english.long_meaning: Fayyazat is an Arabic name derived from the root Fayyaz, meaning blessings and abundance, this name is used in Islamic tradition for prayer and worship, and is also used as a given name for girls in many Muslim cultures

data.cultural_impact: The name Fayyazat carries a profound cultural significance as it symbolizes the idea of being a source of happiness and joy. In Islamic culture, the name encourages positivity and the spreading of joy. The name Fayyazat is often given to babies as a way to foster an environment of happiness and joy in their lives. It also reflects the belief that one should strive to bring happiness and joy to those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fayyazat holds deep significance as it reminds us of the importance of spreading happiness and joy in the world. In Islamic teachings, it is believed that bringing happiness and joy to others is a means of pleasing Allah (God). Furthermore, the name Fayyazat can be seen as a reminder of the blessings that come from Allah and encourages us to be grateful for the joy and happiness that comes into our lives. By living a life aimed at bringing joy and happiness to others, we can connect more deeply with the divine and find spiritual fulfillment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Delightful one" symbolizes One who is a source of delight and joy. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fayyazat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of delightful one.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Fayyazat remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
